review.why: Read a codebase and recommend the Claude Code hooks, subagents, skills, plugins and MCP servers that fit it, one or two per type.
review.summary: A read-only analysis workflow: detect the stack, config and CI from project files, then map signals to recommendations across five automation types, with templates and a fixed report format. Reference files hold hook patterns (format, lint, protect secrets and lock files), MCP servers, skill and subagent templates and official plugins. It also covers headless claude -p use in CI.
strengths: Read-only: it only recommends, and caps output at the one or two most valuable items per category.
Concrete signal-to-recommendation tables and ready templates for hooks and subagents.
Tells the agent to search beyond its lists for tools specific to the codebase.
cautions: The tables name specific plugins and MCP servers that will age as the ecosystem changes.
Recommendations are generic starting points; the user still builds and tests each automation.
SKILL.md read in full, the hooks reference in part, the other four reference files by headings; not run here.
